I did not write the files, because your request rules out tool use and I can't create files without a tool. Both files are below, ready to save as `layout.md` and `CLAUDE.md`. If you lift the restriction, I'll write them directly.

## layout.md

```markdown
# Claude Code context layout for atlas

| Location | Mechanism | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `/CLAUDE.md` | Always-loaded memory | Org-wide conventions (commits, `make check`, trunk-based) apply to every task, so they belong in every session, kept short. |
| `/api/CLAUDE.md` | Subdirectory memory, loaded on demand | The `api/gen/` warning only matters when working in `api/`, so it stays out of web and pipeline sessions. |
| `/web/CLAUDE.md` | Subdirectory memory, loaded on demand | The `npm test` (Playwright) vs `npm run test:unit` distinction is only relevant to web work. |
| `/pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | Subdirectory memory, loaded on demand | The `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` requirement is only relevant to DAG work. |
| `/.claude/settings.json` (PreToolUse hook on Edit/Write for `api/gen/**`) | Hook | CLAUDE.md is advisory, but silent overwrites of generated code are worth blocking deterministically. The hook's message should point to `make proto`. |
| `/.claude/settings.json` (`permissions.deny` or `ask` for `Bash(npm test:*)`) | Permission rule | Stops accidental browser-launching runs. Allow `npm run test:unit` explicitly. |
| Incident-response runbook as a skill (`incident-response/SKILL.md`), distributed as a company-wide plugin | Skill via plugin | 20 steps are too long to load every session and are needed only during incidents. Since every team uses it identically, one plugin source avoids per-repo copies drifting. Set `disable-model-invocation: true` so it runs only when invoked. |
| `/.mcp.json` warehouse SQL server | MCP server (project scope) | Live queries need a tool, not prose. Use a read-only warehouse role, with credentials from env vars and never committed. |
| Optional `metrics` skill for analysts | Skill | Holds metric definitions and table conventions, loaded only when someone asks about product metrics. |
| Optional org-wide managed CLAUDE.md | Managed policy memory | If IT can deploy it, the three shared conventions could live there instead of the repo root. Otherwise the root CLAUDE.md covers it. |

## Principles
- CLAUDE.md holds short, always-true facts. Procedures go in skills. Hard guarantees go in hooks and permissions. External systems go through MCP.
- Service quirks sit next to the code they affect.
```

## CLAUDE.md

```markdown
# atlas

Monorepo with three services:
- `api/`: Go, gRPC
- `web/`: React/TypeScript
- `pipeline/`: Python, Airflow

Service-specific notes are in each directory's CLAUDE.md.

## Conventions (all services)
- Use conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, etc.).
- `make check` must pass before opening any PR.
- Trunk-based development: short-lived branches only, no long-lived branches.

## Other context
- Incident response: use the `incident-response` skill. Don't improvise the runbook.
- Product metrics: use the warehouse MCP server (read-only SQL).
```

The per-service files would be one or two lines each:

- **`api/CLAUDE.md`:** Never hand-edit anything under `api/gen/`. It is generated by `make proto`, and edits are silently overwritten. Change the `.proto` source and regenerate.
- **`web/CLAUDE.md`:** Don't run `npm test`, because it opens real browsers via Playwright. Use `npm run test:unit` for unit tests.
- **`pipeline/CLAUDE.md`:** Set `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` before importing or testing DAGs, or they won't import.
